answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Comb builder wax sheet seal sealed by the mead hall. It demands each wax sheet is a measured honey yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must draw a hundred real combs by hand, and the wander is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The nebula is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The anchor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
